objective: 修复Strategy leaf规则对dispatch policy的错误依赖并强化真实零派发证据

semantic_brief.summary: WI-RESAR-003的真实路径已运行，但leaf规则通过dispatch handling间接识别，且bounds-based Tap测试使用了无效的element-index断言。本修复把closed typed category直接映射到admitted rule，并用可区分bounds证明零派发。
core_points: RecordOnly判断不依赖dispatch policy包含leaf handling
ExpandContainer之后才解析dispatch policy并进入authorization
零派发断言使用可区分fresh bounds而非空element index
exhaustive cutoff保持既有reason逐字一致

change_principles: 在既有Model探索规则层增加internal纯typed resolver，把TypeLevelElementCategory.NavigableContainer映射到semantics.ContainerRule、StateChangingControl映射到semantics.LeafRule，未定义类别fail closed；Agent不得引用Planning命名空间或比较enum字符串/数字
Strategy-bound non-boundary分类后先解析ExplorationRule；RecordOnly直接写fresh observation evidence并continue，不查询dispatch policy、不调用CandidateAuthorizationEvaluator、不派发
ExpandContainer才允许查询dispatch policy，且只有EnterAndTraverse可继续existing grounding/authorization/Traversal；缺失、Forbidden或非展开handling均fail closed
Strategy-bound boundary disposition为RecordOnly时，对每个source observation分类并写RecordOnly satisfaction；只有其基础rule为ExpandContainer的identity写unknown frontier，不依赖dispatch policy mapping
测试binding必须删除StateChangingControl dispatch mapping仍使classified leaf RecordOnly成功，证明rule不依赖可执行handling
测试fixture为root container、child leaf和deep boundary使用互不重叠bounds；零派发必须按TargetBounds范围断言，不得依赖TargetElementIndex或固定总点击数
acceptance: leaf测试在dispatch policy仅含NavigableContainer映射时仍RecordOnly成功，authorization candidates不含leaf，AuthorizedSiblingEvidence不含leaf，且leaf bounds无Tap/SetSwitch
unclassifiable测试断言authorization candidates不含identity、AuthorizedSiblingEvidence不含identity、identity bounds零Tap且UnresolvedNodes精确包含1
container测试断言authorization包含container、存在该container Tap、trace包含verified parent return，并且最终CompletedSiblingEvidence包含identity
depth0和N inspect boundary测试按各自唯一bounds证明boundary identity零dispatch；N inspect仍写RecordOnly与unknown frontier identity
N exhaustive断言Agent.Reason与既有cutoff reason逐字一致，legacy depth/unresolved回归保持绿色
全部WI-RESAR-003/004定向测试通过，dotnet build src/UniClaw.Runtime.sln为0 error且git diff仅scope.write
forbidden: 禁止用ToString、enum name、整数值、UI文字或场景知识判断production category
禁止修改ledger compiler、OpenSpec、文档、WorkItem或其他已有改动
escalation: 若typed resolver需要公开schema或改变TypeLevelElementCategory定义位置，停止并返回BLOCKED_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW
若删除leaf dispatch mapping后无法维持RecordOnly，保留失败证据并返回Leader
若bounds证据显示意外dispatch且修复超出scope，停止并返回BLOCKED_FOR_SPEC
